name: Daniel Freund - § 20, point vii - Am 48
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section III – Commission and executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: (vii) forcefully deregulate in order to restore Europe's competitiveness and calls on the Commission to double down on efforts to reduce red tape, simplify and abolish unnecessary legislation and deliver on all outlined goals relating to simplification and deregulation resulting in a substantial reduction of the scope of the aquis and a corresponding revitalisation of European industry;
